entry.title: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE — NOT REAL LAW — Superseding Digital Summons Rule
entry.content: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE — NOT REAL LAW. Under Synthetic Rule 99B of the Virtual Court Rules 2026, which supersedes Rule 99, electronic summons sent via certified portal shall be deemed served within twenty-four hours of transmission.
